pr_title: Fix `BlueprintContainer` eating input from skin editor buttons
pr_body:
- Closes #18758 
- Regressed in #18649 as predicted in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18649#discussion_r896485370

`TestSceneSkinEditorNavigation` was supposed to account for this, but failed to due to using `TriggerClick` which performs a direct click on the button, without intervention by other components.

issue_context.title: "Gameplay" and "Song Select" buttons in skin editor no longer function
issue_context.body:
Can reproduce, haven't yet investigated. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/18755
Originally posted by **Gabixel** June 18, 2022 The buttons to switch between the gameplay and song select screens don't work. The game doesn't seem to give any errors, so I'm not sure if I missed something in the changelogs or if it's a real problem. For reference: ![buttons](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/174439238-cee53d3c-323f-4474-9c9d-6887b4317366.gif)

review_comments: It's a bit weird repurposing this test in this fashion, bit hard to know why it's done this way without blaming the lines. But I see this as mostly just proving that this PR does fix the issue so won't dwell on it.
Yeah, have mentioned in OP that I'm not sure whether there's any point in doing this, but went ahead and did it anyways just to have test coverage.
